div.div:
سُؤْرٌ A remainder, or residue; (T, M, Msb, K;) of a thing, (M,) or of anything; (TA;) as also ↓ سُؤْرَةٌ : (T:) or a remainder of beverage in the bottom of a vessel after one has drunk; (S, * A;) such as is left by a rat or mouse &c. after drinking: (S:) properly applied to a remainder of water left by the drinker in a vessel or wateringtrough: and tropically to (tropical:) a remainder of food, &c.: (Mgh:) and ↓ سُؤْرَةٌ signifies likewise (tropical:) a remainder of food: (A:) pl. of the former أَسْآرٌ, (S, M, Mgh, Msb,) and, by transposition, آسَارٌ, like آبَارٌ and آرَامٌ, pls. of بِئْرٌ and رِئْمٌ. (M.) [See also سَائِرٌ, below.] ―
-b2- الصَّقْرِ ↓ سُؤْرَةُ means (tropical:) What remains of the portion of the flesh of the game that is given to the hawk which has captured it. (A.) ―
-b3- And ↓ سُؤْرَةٌ also signifies (tropical:) A remainder of youthful vigour in a man, (M, K,) or in a woman who has passed the prime of youth, (Lth,) or in a woman who has passed the period of youth but not been rendered decrepit by old age. (A.) [See also سُؤْدَةٌ.] ―
-b4- And (assumed tropical:) What is good, or excellent, of property, or of camels or the like: pl. سُؤَرٌ. (L.) [App. because such is left when one has parted with the bad.] ―
-b5- ↓ سُؤْرَةٌ مِنَ القُرْآنِ (tropical:) [means A chapter of the Kur-án;] so called because it is a portion, (A,) or a remainder: (TA:) or it may be from the signification immediately preceding: (L:) or it is a dial. var. of سُورَةٌ: (K:) pl. سُؤَرٌ. (A, TA.) ―
-b6- فُلَانٌ سُؤْرُ شَرٍّ means Such a one is very evil or mischievous. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
